reconstruction_instructions: Read every listed carrier reference as exact UTF-8 source and check carrier length/SHA256.
Decode /data_b64, check raw chunk length/SHA256 and concatenate in offset order.
Check aggregate length/SHA256, decompress gzip and tar without modifying member bytes.
Check every original filename, byte length and SHA256 against originals mappings.
Repeat for supplement carrier. All 17 PNGs are original bytes; no resizing/reencoding. Optional binary .godot cache is inventoried, not delivered.
